digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III (Chikunguni); Maundu & Tengnäs 2005 ('Giriama/Digo: Mfunda')

teaser.en: A tree of rocky coastal places whose white pea-flowers give way to flat woody pods, and whose Digo name depends on whom you ask.
teaser.sw: Mti wa maeneo ya miamba ya pwani ambao maua yake meupe kama ya kunde hufuatwa na maganda bapa magumu, na ambao jina lake la Kidigo hutegemea unamuuliza nani.

summary.en: *Chikunguni* is a tree of the coastal belt, often found in rocky places, with leaves of three to five leaflets, white pea-flowers and flat woody pods. It is a source of timber.
summary.sw: *Chikunguni* ni mti wa ukanda wa pwani, mara nyingi hupatikana katika maeneo ya miamba, wenye majani ya vijani vitatu hadi vitano, maua meupe kama ya kunde na maganda bapa magumu kama mti. Ni chanzo cha mbao.

about.en: *Chikunguni* is a tree of the pea family. Its leaves are compound, each made of three to five leaflets. Its flowers are white and shaped like pea-flowers, and they are followed by flat, woody pods that split open to release the seeds.
about.sw: *Chikunguni* ni mti wa familia ya kunde. Majani yake ni mchanganyiko, kila moja likiwa na vijani vitatu hadi vitano. Maua yake ni meupe na yana umbo la maua ya kunde, na hufuatwa na maganda bapa magumu kama mti yanayopasuka ili kuachilia mbegu.

where.en: It grows in the coastal belt, often in rocky places.
where.sw: Huota katika ukanda wa pwani, mara nyingi katika maeneo ya miamba.

uses.en: It is a source of timber.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *chikunguni*, while Maundu and Tengnäs give *mfunda* as the Giriama and Digo name. Pakia uses *mfunda* for a different tree, *Cynometra suaheliensis*. In Swahili it is *mfunda mweupe*, the 'white *mfunda*', and in Giriama *mfunda*. No English name is in common use; its scientific name is *Craibia brevicaudata*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *chikunguni*, ilhali Maundu na Tengnäs wanatoa *mfunda* kama jina la Kigiriama na Kidigo. Pakia anatumia *mfunda* kwa mti mwingine, *Cynometra suaheliensis*. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mfunda mweupe*, yaani '*mfunda* wa rangi nyeupe', na kwa Kigiriama *mfunda*. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza linalotumika kwa kawaida; jina lake la kisayansi ni *Craibia brevicaudata*.

reason.en: Another tree of the pea family; a Cynometra like Pakia's mfunda
reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa familia ya kunde; Cynometra kama mfunda wa Pakia

reason.en: Pea-family timber tree of the coast
reason.sw: Mti wa mbao wa familia ya kunde wa pwani

reason.en: Another pea-family tree with flat pods
reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa familia ya kunde wenye maganda bapa
